name: Exploring Munnar
description: A fully customized travel and tourism booking platform designed to help users discover and book the best experiences in Munnar. The website offers hotel reservations, cab bookings, bike rentals, self-drive car rentals, tour itineraries, local activities, and travel information through an intuitive user interface. It includes a comprehensive admin panel for managing users, hotels, bookings, activities, itineraries, transport schedules, reports, and live updates, ensuring seamless operations and an enhanced customer experience.

name: VPS Infra Associates
description: A fully customized corporate website developed for a construction and infrastructure company, designed to showcase its services, completed projects, and business profile with a modern, professional, and responsive interface.

name: Intercity Riders
description: A fully customized intercity taxi booking platform designed to provide seamless one-way, round-trip, and airport transfer services across Tamil Nadu. The website offers an intuitive booking experience, transparent pricing, responsive design, and quick inquiry options, ensuring a convenient and reliable travel experience for customers.

name: Covai Home Tech
description: A fully customized service-based website developed for a home appliance repair company, offering AC, washing machine, refrigerator, and TV repair services. The website provides clear service information, quick contact options, online service inquiries, and a responsive user interface to enhance customer convenience.
features: AC, Refrigerator, TV & Washing Machine Services

name: Gym Hack
description: A fully customized product-based eCommerce website for GymHack, designed to showcase and sell premium fitness nutrition products such as oats and muesli. The website includes a powerful admin panel for easy product management, inventory updates, order tracking, customer management, and seamless online shopping, ensuring a smooth experience for both customers and administrators.

Integrated secure online payment system supporting multiple payment methods, enabling customers to complete purchases safely and conveniently with real-time payment confirmation and seamless checkout experience

name: Purple Drop Taxi
description: A fully customized taxi booking website developed for Purple Drop Taxi, designed to provide a simple, reliable, and user- friendly travel booking experience across Tamil Nadu. The website allows customers to easily explore taxi services, check transparent pricing, select their preferred vehicle, and submit trip details through a convenient online booking system.

The platform supports multiple travel requirements including one-way trips, round trips, airport pickup and drop, and outstation travel. It is designed with a responsive and mobile- friendly interface, clear call and WhatsApp options, and an
easy-to-use booking form to help customers plan their journeys quickly and conveniently.

name: Taerg Laundry
description: A fully customized premium laundry service website developed for TAERG Laundry, designed to provide customers with a simple and convenient way to access professional garment care services. The website showcases TAERG’s specialized cleaning solutions for everyday clothing as well as premium garments such as silk sarees, blazers, lehengas, designer wear, uniforms, shoes, bags, and more.

The website features an easy-to-use service booking system, detailed service information, pickup and delivery options, and a responsive mobile-friendly interface. It also highlights TAERG’s advanced SoftWash wet-cleaning technology, offering
gentle and professional care for delicate and premium fabrics while delivering a smooth digital experience from service discovery to booking.

name: Hita Home Décor
description: Hita Home Décor brings heritage-inspired home accents and curated gifts into one welcoming shopping experience. The presented design pairs warm brown tones, soft neutrals, and considered product imagery to reflect the care behind the collection.

Clear product categories help visitors explore dining pieces, vases, kitchen accessories, decorative accents, organisers, and gifting options. A dedicated bulk-gifting feature introduces collections for weddings, housewarmings, corporate occasions, festivals, and celebrations.

Delivery, product quality, gifting, and support are highlighted early in the design, so visitors can understand the offering before exploring the products. The overall direction feels calm and personal, with a clear path from discovering a piece to making an enquiry.
features: Category-led browsing for home décor and accessories
Bulk gifting for personal and corporate occasions
Prominent delivery, quality, and support information
Visible product discovery, account, and contact navigation

name: TopGrade
coverTitle: Built for the moments that matter.
description: An education platform built for scheduling lessons, sharing coursework, and running digital tests. This case study explains how its data and submission workflows changed as exam-day demand grew.

caseStudy.title: The situation
paragraphs: TopGrade built an easy way to schedule lessons, share coursework and run digital tests. In the early days, one server handled the daily activity comfortably.

Then more universities joined, and use changed from steady browsing to sudden rushes: a huge number of students handing in timed exams within the same minute. The shared database jammed, grading jobs backed up, and teachers could not open student records.

caseStudy.title: The real problem
caseStudy.heading: One college’s exam slowing down everyone else.
paragraphs: When one college ran a big exam, the database got so busy that it locked the shared question tables. A different college, only trying to check attendance, found its pages timing out.
The first instinct was to pay for a much bigger database. But that is an expensive patch, and it fails again when traffic doubles during final exams. The way the data was organised had to change.

caseStudy.title: What we did
paragraphs: We changed how data is stored and read, and separated receiving answers from the heavy work of marking them:

steps.label: 01 / ARCHITECTURE
steps.heading: Each college gets its own space
steps.text: We split the data by college, so a rush at one college can never use up the capacity or lock the tables of another.

steps.label: 02 / BACKEND
steps.heading: Submitting an exam is instant
steps.text: A submission is now saved safely in a queue straight away, so students are not kept waiting while marking happens behind the scenes.

steps.label: 03 / DATA LAYER
steps.heading: Popular content is saved for quick access
steps.text: Course outlines and question banks are kept in a fast memory store that refreshes automatically, taking a large share of the reading work off the main database.

steps.label: 04 / OPERATIONS
steps.heading: Live visibility on exam day
steps.text: We added live dashboards for queue length and database load, so each college’s IT team can see how things are going during important tests.

caseStudy.title: The Result
caseStudy.heading: Steady speed during busy exam sessions on a shared platform.
paragraphs: TopGrade took on several university networks without rebuilding the platform. Busy exam periods no longer cause one college to slow down another.
Some details are generalised to respect client confidentiality. Specific figures are shared on a call.

caseStudy.title: What we learned
caseStudy.heading: Exam traffic arrives all at once.
paragraphs: Most websites see traffic rise and fall gradually. Exam platforms see sudden cliffs: a few users at 9:59 and a huge crowd at 10:00. Slow automatic scaling will let students down every time. The reliable answer is to separate receiving answers from processing them, and to keep each college’s data path separate.

name: OneWay Drop Taxi
description: A website for a one-way drop taxi service provider, with complete UI/UX design and development by Wexoraa Infotech.

The design gives travellers a clear starting point for planning a journey, with prominent service, tariff, route, and contact information. A warm orange and dark-brown visual direction makes key actions easy to spot.
The experience is organised around helping visitors explore the service and take the next step towards a trip enquiry, with clear navigation and accessible contact options.
features: Service, tariff, and route information design
Consistent visual design for a one-way taxi brand
